title: RATatouille: Today’s Special: Impersonating Companies in Korea, Payments in Cryptocurrency
content_md: While tracking infrastructure related to ValleyRAT, numerous suspicious websites were identified that impersonated companies and brands from Korea such as Doosan Robotics and Cheonjeong. The identified sites used the actual companies’ logos, promotional videos, and descriptions to disguise themselves as official websites.
